label: Fase 1: subtitle player native (uji)
notes: Fase 1 player native: subtitle kini jalan di player native jalur anime. Trek mentah + tier id-gtx/id-gtxplus/id-ai dikirim ke ExoPlayer, offset timing cap 30 dtk ikut tersimpan, varian trek tampil. Toggle Spike tetap OFF secara default. Uji: Ao Ashi ep 1, cek subtitle Indonesia aktif, geser offset, ganti varian, Back lalu cek offset tersimpan.
